description: Two same-packet methods on the three above-threshold families; compare previous fractional refinement to confidence-gated independent path motion.
authorization: 2026-11-25 active goal in Codex chat 01a21321-6c4d-7041-a91c-dc163206a8b6. Reduce each source diagnostic family channel-action NMSE below 0.1 percent.

data.physical_ids_ref: Same 60 independently sampled source V as the path-motion diagnostic; used frozen paired IQ from that run, no use of that run scores when selecting the estimator.
data.train_ratio: Gate selected using nested time-block source U holdout. 60 source V packets with six original conditions and three matched double-power cases.
data.split_id: WiSig immutable source U and V; no target
data.support_query_ref: N/A Phase1; experiment has no support set

permissions.claim_scope: Only same-packet source clean and received IQ used for estimation; simulator references only in stimulus generation and independent scoring. No TX truth, recognition model, target or deployment results.

checkpoint.initialization: Analytic paired-IQ estimation, no model weights
checkpoint.selection_rule: Four-fold observed IQ predictions, penalty 5, shrink factor two estimated standard deviations and blend cap 1 fixed by anonymous source-U nested holdout.

execution.stop_rule: Stop on input contract, numeric failure, estimator output completeness or wrong scorer closure.

metric_names: ideal known-shape complex gain estimate reference

rows.resolved_config_ref: Fixed nuisance and blend options in wisig_adaptive_path_audit.py and parent frozen refinement configuration.json
rows.seed_notes: No stochastic trained model or support adaptation. The fixed panel selects archived Practical draws and seeds generated non-Practical cases.
rows.scenario: Multipath burst, fractional clock and time-selective; six original and three double-power conditions
rows.budget_ref: One paired packet; four 192-sample fits and one 256-sample final estimate.
